title: NPDev browser-AI relay: configuration proposal (npdev-config-proposal.json)
description: D-9 / plan 4.9 / F4. The AI never sends config.json; it PROPOSES property changes. Each change is applied only if 'property' has an entry in NPDevCli/relay-config-allowlist.json, its value passes that entry's type/values, and the user leaves its preview line ticked. The writer is the CLI, never a file paste. Anything else is shown as 'the AI suggested changing X; you can do that in Settings'.
